title: Not where it says on the ticket: the airports and stations far from their namesake
excerpt: Frankfurt-Hahn is 103 km from Frankfurt and Paris Vatry 136 km from Paris. I measured how far every airport and every UK railway station stands from the place in its name, and checked every long case by hand.
seo_description: How far airports and UK stations stand from their namesake: Paris Vatry 136 km from Paris, Hahn 103 km from Frankfurt, Dent and Llanbister Road.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Not where it says on the ticket' beside two small maps with lines from Frankfurt-Hahn to Frankfurt, 103 km, and from Paris Vatry to Paris, 136 km.
